story.title: Our story
story.quote: True luxury begins with what you wear closest to your skin.
story.originP1: It began with a simple observation: underwear is often treated as a basic, even though it is the first garment we put on every morning. Yet it shapes our comfort, confidence and well-being throughout the day.
story.originP2: AJ Luxury was born from that conviction.
story.peopleStatement: Alex and Jérémy are the co-founders of AJ Luxury. Together, they shape the collections and build the brand’s world.
story.definitionTitle: No excess. Simply the precision of every detail.
story.definitionP1: Our ambition is to reinvent this everyday essential by creating underwear that brings together elegance, comfort and quality without compromise.
story.definitionP2: Comfort is a genuine source of self-confidence.
product.description.pourpre: Discover Apollon Pourpre Impérial, a men’s boxer designed for those seeking the perfect balance of elegance, comfort and refinement.
product.description.rose-pale: Discover Apollon Rose Velours, a piece that subtly and elegantly reinvents men’s underwear.
product.description.lilas-bleu-clair: Discover Apollon Lilas Céleste, a men’s boxer where softness meets contemporary elegance.
product.detail.pourpre.1: Made from a soft blend of 94% modal and 6% elastane, it offers a silky feel, excellent breathability and a second-skin sensation. Its classic boxer cut follows the body naturally while allowing complete freedom of movement throughout the day.
product.detail.pourpre.2: Its 3.5 cm elastic waistband, finished with the metallic AJ Luxury logo, delivers an elegant signature and comfortable support.
product.detail.pourpre.3: The deep, sophisticated Pourpre Impérial shade embodies confidence and character. A timeless piece that elevates your underwear collection.
product.detail.rose-pale.1: Made from 94% modal and 6% elastane, this boxer offers exceptional softness, excellent breathability and the ideal stretch to follow your silhouette with comfort and elegance.
product.detail.rose-pale.2: Its 3.5 cm elastic waistband, adorned with the metallic AJ Luxury logo, provides a premium finish and a distinctive brand signature.
product.detail.rose-pale.3: The soft, refined Rose Velours shade reveals a modern and confident aesthetic for men who want comfort, style and self-assurance.
product.detail.lilas-bleu-clair.1: Made from a premium blend of 94% modal and 6% elastane, it provides exceptional comfort through a lightweight, breathable fabric that feels smooth against the skin. Its classic boxer cut moves naturally with the body while ensuring a precise fit.
product.detail.lilas-bleu-clair.2: The 3.5 cm waistband, enhanced by the metallic AJ Luxury logo, gives this piece a luxurious finish and a strong identity.
product.detail.lilas-bleu-clair.3: The delicate, luminous Lilas Céleste shade brings a modern, original touch while retaining a confident masculine elegance.
